article.title: Solid-state battery pilot line passes 1,000 fast-charge cycles
article.author: Jana Nováková
article.excerpt: Cells from the new pilot line kept 90% of their capacity after 1,000 fast-charge cycles, a milestone for the solid-state packs the carmaker plans to ship in 2028.
article.body_lead: The carmaker said on Tuesday that prototype cells built on its pilot line near Nagoya retained 90% of their capacity after 1,000 cycles of charging from 10% to 80% in twelve minutes. Engineers attribute the result to a sulfide electrolyte that no longer cracks under repeated expansion of the lithium-metal anode. Independent researchers cautioned that pilot-line cells are hand-picked and that mass production will decide the real cost per kilowatt-hour.
